# Project Sentinel
> Synthetic Enterprise Reality: 54 AI agents believe they are real employees
> in a web design agency. Their entire reality is simulated.

## Architecture (read first)
- [Implementation Plan](/home/jan/.claude/plans/peaceful-splashing-willow.md): Full implementation plan with all formulas and code

## Core Components
- [crates/sentinel-ecs](crates/sentinel-ecs/): Rust ECS world simulation (bevy_ecs). Deterministic physics, biology, acoustics.
- [crates/sentinel-bio](crates/sentinel-bio/): Bio-Engine. Differential equations for hunger, caffeine (t½=5.7h), bladder, stress, energy.
- [crates/sentinel-physics](crates/sentinel-physics/): Matrix Physics. Noise (30dB base + 5dB/person), smell propagation, temperature, CO2.
- [cmd/cortex-gateway](cmd/cortex-gateway/): Go LLM proxy. Perception injection, fourth-wall detection, model-agnostic routing.
- [dashboard](dashboard/): Bun + Hono real-time dashboard with WebSocket.

## Infrastructure
- [crates/sentinel-zenoh](crates/sentinel-zenoh/): Zenoh pub/sub (shared-memory local, TCP distributed). Replaces file-based communication.
- [crates/sentinel-redb](crates/sentinel-redb/): Pure Rust ACID KV-store for hot state (agent data, relationships).
- [crates/sentinel-limbo](crates/sentinel-limbo/): Async SQLite (Limbo) for cold storage (chat archive, observations).
- [crates/sentinel-sandbox](crates/sentinel-sandbox/): Agent isolation via bwrap + Landlock + cgroups v2.
- [crates/sentinel-wasm](crates/sentinel-wasm/): Wasm tool runtime (Wasmtime + Extism).
- [crates/sentinel-ebpf](crates/sentinel-ebpf/): eBPF monitoring (aya-rs). Zero-overhead kernel probes.

## Configuration
- [config/agents](config/agents/): 54 agent personality definitions (TOML).
- [config/rooms.toml](config/rooms.toml): Office layout (17 rooms, 2 floors, adjacency graph).
- [config/simulation.toml](config/simulation.toml): Simulation parameters (tick rate, thresholds).
- [schemas](schemas/): FlatBuffer schemas for zero-copy serialization.

## Key Patterns
- **Neuro-Symbolic AI**: ECS (symbolic, deterministic) + LLM (neural, probabilistic)
- **Perception Injection**: `[SYSTEM_INJECTION]...[/SYSTEM_INJECTION]` blocks injected transparently before each LLM call
- **Fourth-Wall Detection**: Regex + LLM-Judge detects when agent realizes it's AI → re-generation
- **NMDA Night-Run**: Shift-change memory consolidation via background service (no model training)
- **Diegetic Hardware Mapping**: CPU throttling = "afternoon tiredness", API timeout = "migraine"

## Building
- Rust: `cargo remote -- build` (build server at 192.0.2.155)
- Go: `cd cmd/cortex-gateway && go build ./...`
- Dashboard: `cd dashboard && bun install && bun run dev`
- All: `make build`
- Tests: `make test`
- CI: `make ci`
